maddeler.e:
ارتجيا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَجَيَا (irtajayā) /ir.ta.d͡ʒa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
# اُرْتُجِيَا (urtujiyā) /ur.tu.d͡ʒi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
# اِرْتَجِيَا (irtajiyā) /ir.ta.d͡ʒi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَجَى (irtajā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
